Name: Malchi-shua, Son of Saul
Summary: Malchi-shua, spelled Melchi-shua in 1 Samuel 14, was a son of Saul who died with his father and brothers on Mount Gilboa.
KeyStory: Malchi-shua died beside his father on the day Israel's first kingdom fell.
RelatedPeople: King Saul; Jonathan; Abinadab, Son of Saul
LifeLesson: A dynasty's fall sweeps up sons who never chose the throne.
